params.name: Carrier_Type
params.description: "omega-d-glass" is a single-piece Omega-D carrier with a pocket for a 4x5 glass plate (see the Glass Plate Carrier section)

params.name: Frame_Count
params.description: Consecutive frames the opening spans (one exposure prints them side by side). Ignored for 4x5 and custom.

params.name: Top_or_Bottom
params.description: Top or bottom of the carrier

params.name: Alignment_Board
params.description: Include the alignment board?

params.name: Flip_Bottom_For_Printing
params.description: Flip bottom carriers to printable orientation (rotate 180° on X-axis)

params.name: Printed_or_Heat_Set_Pegs
params.description: Printed or heat-set pegs? Heat set pegs required when including alignment board.

params.name: Heat_Set_Screw_Size
params.description: Heat-set pegs only: the machine screw (e.g. M2x4 socket head) that threads into the bottom carrier and whose head registers the top. Sizes both holes.

params.name: Heat_Set_Screw_Head
params.description: Heat-set pegs only: the screw's head style. The top carrier's hole clears the head (its diameter is the standard max for the size), so it must match the screws you actually use. "custom" uses Heat_Set_Screw_Head_Diameter.

params.name: Heat_Set_Screw_Head_Diameter
params.description: Heat-set pegs only: the measured head diameter (mm, calipers across the head) when Heat_Set_Screw_Head is "custom". The top hole adds 0.5mm clearance.

params.name: Custom_Film_Width
params.description: Actual film stock width (for peg positioning)

params.name: Custom_Film_Height
params.description: Actual film stock height (for film handling)

params.name: Custom_Opening_Width
params.description: Film opening width (the visible/cropped area)

params.name: Custom_Opening_Height
params.description: Film opening height (the visible/cropped area)

params.name: Glass_Plate_Width
params.description: Plate size across the carrier, the short edge (mm)

params.name: Glass_Plate_Length
params.description: Plate size along the carrier width, the long edge (mm)

params.name: Glass_Plate_Thickness
params.description: Thickest plate the pocket must take (mm); 4x5 dry plates run 1.8-2.0

params.name: Glass_Plate_Side_Play
params.description: Clearance between the plate and the pocket wall, per side (mm)

params.name: Glass_Plate_Depth_Play
params.description: Extra pocket depth beyond the plate thickness (mm), so the plate never stands proud

params.name: Glass_Notch_Diameter
params.description: Diameter of the circular finger notch at a pocket corner that lets you lift the plate out (0 = none)

params.name: Glass_Notch_Corner
params.description: Pocket corner that gets the finger notch ("handle" = the -X handle side)

params.name: Glass_Notch_Floor
params.description: Material left under the finger notch (mm); 0 cuts it through

params.name: Glass_Notch_Reach
params.description: How far the notch reaches under the plate edge (mm) for a nail to hook it; keep below the rim between pocket and opening (3.5mm for 4x5)

params.name: Glass_Board_Screw_Counterbore
params.description: Counterbore depth (mm) for the screw heads in the separately printed alignment board, cut from the face the screws go in from, so the heads sit mostly inside the 1.7mm board (0 = none). Sized for the peg screw head + 0.5mm. Leave at least ~0.7mm of board under the head.

params.name: Enable_Owner_Name_Etch
params.description: Enable or disable the owner name etching

params.name: Owner_Name
params.description: Name to etch on the carrier

params.name: Enable_Type_Name_Etch
params.description: Enable or disable the type name etching

params.name: Custom_Type_Name
params.description: Custom type name, if Type Name is "custom"

params.name: Fontface
params.description: Font to use for the etchings

params.name: Font_Size
params.description: Font size for etchings

params.name: TEXT_ETCH_DEPTH
params.description: Depth for etching

params.name: Owner_Text_X_Offset
params.description: Adjust text location relative to carrier defaults (mm)

params.name: Text_As_Separate_Parts
params.description: Render text as separate parts for multi-material printing

params.name: Layer_Height_mm
params.description: Desired slicer layer height (mm)

params.name: Text_Layer_Multiple
params.description: Number of layers for text thickness (multiple of layer height)

params.name: _WhichPart
params.description: Select which part to render when exporting STLs

params.name: _Render_Alignment_Board_Only
params.description: parameter sets (-p/-P, which the web app uses) skip Hidden variables.

params.name: Peg_Gap
params.description: Leave at 0 for default gap. Measured in mm. Add positive values to increase the gap between pegs and film edge, subtract (use negative values) to decrease it. Default 0 allows for little wiggle.

params.name: Adjust_Film_Width
params.description: Leave at 0 for no adjustment. Measured in mm. Add positive values to increase the film width, subtract (use negative values) to decrease it.

params.name: Adjust_Film_Height
params.description: Leave at 0 for no adjustment. Measured in mm. Add positive values to increase the film height, subtract (use negative values) to decrease it.

params.name: Heat_Set_Thread_Hole_Adjust
params.description: Heat-set pegs only. Added to the diameter (mm) of the bottom carrier's screw holes, which the screw threads into (default M2: 1.9mm). Use +0.1..0.2 if the screw won't start, negative if it spins freely.

params.name: Heat_Set_Head_Hole_Adjust
params.description: Heat-set pegs only. Added to the diameter (mm) of the top carrier's screw-head clearance holes (head diameter + 0.5; M2 socket cap: 4.3mm).

params.name: Render_Quality
params.description: Use "preview" for faster F5 preview, "final" for smooth F6 renders

params.name: $fn
params.description: Variable resolution: 32 for preview speed, 100 for final quality

params.name: _FORMAT_TYPE_NAME
params.description: Generate carrier type name for etching (the glass carrier says so, e.g. "4X5 GLASS")

params.name: effective_orientation
params.description: Calculate film opening dimensions once for all carriers

params.name: adjusted_opening_height
params.default: get_custom_aware_opening_height(Film_Format, Orientation, Adjust_Film_Height, Custom_Film_Height, Custom_Film_Width, Custom_Opening_Height, Frame_Count)

params.name: adjusted_opening_width
params.default: get_custom_aware_opening_width(Film_Format, Orientation, Adjust_Film_Width, Custom_Film_Height, Custom_Film_Width, Custom_Opening_Width, Frame_Count)

params.name: peg_diameter
params.description: Get peg diameter from config (index varies by carrier type)

params.name: heat_set_thread_hole_dia_calc
params.description: (bottom: thread-forming hole; top: head clearance). Ignored for printed pegs.
